title: The Midnight Thorn
author: Rafael Oyelaran
blurb: Ivo Kavanagh, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
